story: Stage 4 of the Baloise Belgium Tour 2026 saw a breakaway of six riders, controlled by sprinter teams. The last escapees were caught 3 km before the finish, leading to a mass sprint. Olav Kooij won ahead of Tim Merlier and Jasper Philipsen. Aranburu retains the overall lead.
